newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly higher Thursday despite a further hike in LME stocks and weakening of the London backwardation.
LME stocks rose 3,950 tonnes Thursday to 204,900 tonnes.
COMEX September copper was called up 0.40 to 0.50 cent from Wednesday's close of 105.60 cents a lb.
COMEX copper stocks fell 460 short tonnes to 25,716 short tons Monday.
The LME cash to three months backwardation eased further overnight to $50/$55, off slightly from Wednesday evening.
